goalDescription: Die lernende Person kann Auswirkungen der Digitalisierung auf Märkte analysieren und Folgen für Anbieter und Nachfrager beurteilen.
reviewerModel: Codex; exact serving model identifier not exposed
aspectRatioDecision: Close native16:9 landscape; no exception needed. Format not mechanically normalized.

actualInspection.fachlichePruefung: Independent sellers and consumers are connected across distances through a generic marketplace. Search/comparison opportunity is paired with gate, cost and security questions about platform dependence. No platform brand, universal progress arrow or precise causal guarantee is asserted.
actualInspection.phone: At 360 px four active participants, marketplace/search connection, access and dependence question remain clear; no small offer data is required.
actualInspection.desktop: At 680 px sellers' goods, consumers' selection, fee/gate and security-question motifs clearly distinguish opportunities from concerns.
actualInspection.actorPerspective: All four actual user devices show their backs toward audience and screens toward their users. The large central marketplace laptop is a separate conceptual diagram, not falsely placed as an actor's device.
actualInspection.style: Friendly clear comic raster, coherent broad colors and approachable people without photorealism or sterile technical restyling.

interpretationLimits: The selected opportunities and dependence questions are examples, not an exhaustive catalogue or a guarantee of digital safety or lower costs.
